CHARLES AND LYNN SCHUSTERMAN FAMILY FOUNDATION - GuideStar Profile
Charles and Lynn Schusterman Family Philanthropies

profile.summary: A private grantmaking foundation based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. It gives grants in the United States and Israel in areas including criminal justice, democracy and voting rights, education, gender and reproductive equity, the Tulsa community and Jewish community life. It does not run programs itself. It operates publicly as Charles and Lynn Schusterman Family Philanthropies.
